content.short: LayerZero is a protocol for on-chain cross-communication.
content.description: LayerZero is a cross-chain protocol that enables interaction between separate blockchains and their ecosystems. It accomplishes this with a dedicated oracle and relayer that together handle cross-chain messaging and verification of cross-chain data. By coordinating these components, LayerZero supports communication across blockchains. The protocol supports a wide array of blockchains, including Aptos, Avalanche, Polygon, and Harmony, reflecting its goal to connect multiple networks via cross-chain messaging.
